paper_title: A Characterization of Optimal-Rate Linear Homomorphic Secret Sharing Schemes, and Applications
statement: We also remark that, when Theorems 31 and 30 disagree, we conjecture that the construction (Theorem 30) is the correct one. Indeed, our construction in Theorem 30 follows from “puffing up” a totally nonsingular (TN) matrix; the value of the parameter j has to do with the field size over which this TN matrix is defined. In fact, assuming the MDS conjecture for extension fields, the field size that we use in our construction – and hence the value of j – is the best possible; see [6] for details. Thus, if Theorem 30 is not optimal, either the MDS conjecture is false over extension fields, or else there is an alternate way to construct Block TN matrices without going through TN matrices over larger fields. Given Lemma 23 and Theorem 27, Theorems 30 and 31 immediately imply the following corollary about linear HSS schemes.
